scientific_integrity: The universal claim follows from finite majorization and an endpoint identity; standalone exact arithmetic checks verify the explicit four-household witnesses. No empirical inference or external scientific certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: All households are equally weighted, with strictly positive incomes, common original total, and one original profile majorizing the other.
Universal rigidity is proved only for at most three households; the four-household example establishes existence, not a prevalence or optimal magnitude.
Concave transformations must be common and positive-valued; transformed profile totals need not remain equal.
A related historical study of top-coding was examined from its abstract only, leaving prior-art uncertainty.
title: Three-household Gini-order rigidity and a sharp four-household reversal under common concave income transformations
